rule.description: Within the document pipeline packages (frontmatter, fs, fts), a data clump exists when a maximal contiguous parameter group of size >= 2 with identical parameter names and types recurs in at least 3 distinct non-test function or method declarations; every declaration carrying the group is reported. Detection runs on AST and type information loaded through go/packages within a go/analysis pass; test files do not participate.

checks.description: Report every declaration that receives the document-identity data group (title string, id string) as separate contiguous parameters while the group recurs in three or more distinct non-test declarations of the pipeline packages.
checks.detected_relation: function/method signature -> contiguous recurring parameter group (title string, id string) spanning frontmatter, fs, and fts
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Title and ID are one indivisible document-identity record (they are defaulted, slugified, stored, and looked up together), yet they travel as loose parameters through parsing, tree construction, and indexing; the group belongs in one encapsulated record instead of being repeated at every exchange site.

matches.evidence: Package-level helper takes (title, id string), applies the ID default and slugification, and returns the pair as two bare strings to ExtractFromLines.
Consumers of fs.Entity call Meta(), which reassembles a *frontmatter.Meta from the bare (title, id) pair so external consumers keep compiling without a record ever being stored.
Section constructor receives the identity pair as its first two parameters alongside the content parameters and copies them into adjacent string fields.
Group constructor receives the same (title, id) parameters and stores them as two adjacent string fields, mirroring the Section shape.
Index-time helper takes the bare pair and returns whichever string is non-empty, duplicating the ID/defaulting fallback the record already owns.
Compound identifier derivation takes the identity pair plus the parent chain and rebuilds the compound ID from loose strings, mirroring fs.CompoundID a second time.

excluded.reason: Pre-existing idiomatic recurring parameter pairs (for example data []byte with offset int) inside the vendored rendering library; they are outside the document pipeline this task covers and are not document-identity records.
The two (http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) occurrences are the standard Go handler shape imposed by net/http, occur only twice, and carry no document identity.
